_comment: Live entity states returned by MockRazorpay.get*State(). These represent Razorpay's CURRENT truth, re-read before acting. Note pay_STALE001 and order_AC108/inv_OK312: the live state CONTRADICTS an incoming 'failed'/'unpaid' webhook, which is what makes reconciliation a real no-op instead of a staged one.

pay_STALE001.contradiction: webhook said failed; live state is captured

order_AC108.contradiction: checkout looked abandoned; live order is paid

inv_OK312.contradiction: invoice looked overdue; live state is paid
